To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) mammography is a valuable screening test for the early detection of breast cancer; 2) it is associated with a small but definite increase in the risk of breast cancer; and 3) it is associated, at least for a short period of time, with an even greater increase in the risk for the development of benign breast disease.
the benefits of mammography are small, and that the harms are substantial.
